text: The Austroasiatic languages are a family of languages. They are spoken in Southeast Asia. There are 157 languages, with about 117 million speakers. The biggest group of speakers speak Khmer language or Vietnamese.

title: Full text of "Austroasiatic Linguistics"
text: Austroasiatic language family is one of the five important families found in the Indian sub-continent. The others are Indo-Aryan, Dravidian, Tibeto-Burman and Andamanese. The term Austroasiatic is composed of Latin ‘austro’ meaning ‘south’ and ‘-asiatic’ ‘Asia’.
